partners.mechanism_chain: AGPS (HGNC:276) —DISRUPTS→ Peroxisomal lipid metabolism (GO:0003997); Peroxisomal lipid metabolism (GO:0003997) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal dysplasia (HP:0002710); HSD17B4 (HGNC:4960) —DISRUPTS→ Very-long-chain fatty acids (CHEBI:37004); Very-long-chain fatty acids (CHEBI:37004) —LEADS_TO→ Ovarian dysgenesis (HP:0011677).
